Thanks for flagging, Ethan. Marta — I pulled the request logs for the invite accept window and I'm seeing Coupa's endpoint return a 502 when our gateway receives an unexpected Content-Length / chunked encoding combination from FreskoGard's proxy. In other words, the SAML POST gets to our edge but the transfer encoding is getting mangled during the handshake.

Requests I need from you (Carlos/Marta):
- A packet-level timestamp (approx) and a browser HAR if possible for your accept attempt (you can export from devtools).
- The name of your proxy appliance/vendor and whether it performs SSL re-signing (some do)

Workarounds while we investigate:
1) I can reissue a fresh invite that uses a different redirect path (shorter TTL) — Laura, can you re-send with a new link?
2) If your IT team can temporarily bypass the proxy for coupa.com (allowlist), that usually avoids the header mangling.

I'll also attach a quick saml-trace-request.txt with the headers we'd like to capture on your side — if you can forward that to your IT team it will speed debugging.

Ben Carter
Identity & Integrations, Redwood Inference
